title: Ep 43 — A Second Quiet News Day, and the Carousel Tool That Split Its Own Story Between Two Numbers
description: A genuinely thin AI news day — nothing dated past yesterday across eighteen tracked sources, though Cursor and ElevenLabs have both gone unusually quiet — makes room for a deep dive on aiCarousels, Fernando Pessagno's solo-built carousel-post generator, niched here into "match-day carousel packs" for PlayFundWin and LeaguePages. Plus the Fundraising Regulator's timeline stays unchanged at early twenty twenty-seven, and the good-causes deadline is three days out with Steve's own submission already done.
